name: tiddlyrpg-dnd
description: D&D content for tiddlyrpg-core (TiddlyRPG repo family): the ruleset tiddlyrpg-ruleset-dnd5e2014 (D&D 5e 2014, terms of the SRD 5.1) and the setting tiddlyrpg-setting-forgottenrealms (Calendar of Harptos, coins of Faerûn). Data and wikitext only, no code. Includes a minimal edition for the boot/smoke check (npm run smoke) and the tests in test/ (npm test).
